report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: sampled checkout traces all return HTTP 200 with successful downstream calls, and order metrics show only version 1.0.0 with no 5xx (502 count 0). The deployment record shows only baseline v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No current evidence substantiates checkout errors or a faulty deployment; error logs were excluded. Insufficient evidence to bound a cause, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Checkout error logs/error spans showing actual failure status codes and messages (order-logs excluded from context).
Metrics for checkout/order error rates by status (e.g., 5xx) over the incident window to confirm errors exist.
Deployment history showing any version change beyond baseline v1.0.0, with timestamps relative to error onset.
Latency/error breakdown per dependency (postgres, redis, payment) to test pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout alternatives.
